title: NEED Grace
summary: A timed per-character buff that Gold Coins activate for 6 hours each, plus weekly convenience passes.

blocks.text: NEED Grace
NEED Grace is a timed per-character buff activated with Gold Coins. Each Gold Coin gives 6 hours, and it applies only to the current character, not the whole account.

blocks.title: Applies per character
blocks.text: NEED Grace applies per character, not per account. Other characters on the same account do not get it.

How to Activate
Use Gold Coins at the dedicated NPC to activate NEED Grace or extend it. Each Gold Coin gives 6 hours.

rows: Adds 6 hours to the NEED Grace buff.
If Grace is already active, the time is added after the time left.

blocks.text: How to Get Gold Coins
The Gold Coins that activate NEED Grace come from server events, writing player guides, community activity rewards and more.

rows: Rewards from events run on the server, such as official events, test participation, hunting efficiency measurements and Battlegrounds tests.
May be given for writing walkthroughs, job guides or content guides that help new and returning players.
May be given for useful activity that helps run the server, such as reports, sharing information and improving guides.

blocks.title: About rewards
blocks.text: How many Gold Coins are given, and when, depends on the event, the quality of the guide and the server situation.
Buff Effects
While NEED Grace is active, its own icon appears in the buff bar, showing the time left and the effects.

blocks.title: Stacks with Bubble Gum
blocks.text: The NEED Grace drop rate bonus applies together with Bubble Gum. The final drop rate may still be capped by the server's drop rate limit.
Weekly Grace Passes

Besides the buff, the NEED Grace Manager sells rental tickets for weekly convenience features. A convenience pass is delivered to your inventory as a ticket; right-click it to see how long it has left.

blocks.title: The buff and the passes are separate
blocks.text: The NEED Grace buff gives stat, HP, SP and drop rate effects. The Trade, Elemental, Storage and All-in-One Grace Passes are a separate system that unlocks convenience features.

rows: Gives the Overcharge and Discount convenience effects while the pass lasts.
Enter @element to choose Water, Wind, Earth or Fire. The endowment lasts 30 minutes.
In town, automatically stores the Usable, Etc and Card items in your inventory that you already have in Storage. Equipment is left out.
All of Trade, Elemental and Storage Grace
One pass gives every Trade, Elemental and Storage Grace feature.

blocks.text: Convenience Commands

rows: With an Elemental or All-in-One Grace Pass active, choose a Water, Wind, Earth or Fire endowment in town.
With a Storage or All-in-One Grace Pass active, automatically puts matching items into Storage in town.
Adds the item to the auto-storage exclusion list.
Removes the item from the auto-storage exclusion list.

blocks.title: Town-only convenience
blocks.text: @autostorage works only in town, so it cannot be abused for weight management or convenience during combat.
Notes
Weekly Grace Passes are per-character rental tickets. Their time is not shared with other characters on the same account.
An active All-in-One Grace Pass gives every Trade, Elemental and Storage Grace feature.
A rental ticket disappears when its time runs out. Check whether a feature is actually available in the in-game Grace status and the NPC's guidance.
NEED Grace applies only to the current character. Logging in with another character on the same account does not share the effect.
Using another pass while Grace is active adds the time after the time left.
Grace effects end automatically when the buff time runs out.
